claims.subject: brago

evidence.quote: It is my solemn duty to inform you that Brago, King of Paliano, is no more.

claims.summary: Brago was the former King of Paliano until his death (past era relative to Marchesa's reign).

claims.subject: marchesa

evidence.quote: As his designated heir, recognized by the sacred order of Custodi as his one true successor

claims.summary: Marchesa claims the throne as Brago's designated heir, recognized by the Custodi.
claims.limitation: Sourced from an in-universe proclamation; the speaker is the proclamation's named author.

claims.subject: marchesa

evidence.quote: sole sovereign of the High City, true heir to the throne of Paliano

claims.summary: Queen Marchesa, the Black Rose, rules Paliano after Brago (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016).
claims.limitation: Sourced from an in-universe proclamation; the speaker is the proclamation's named author.

claims.subject: adriana

evidence.quote: Adriana is the captain of the guard of the High City of Paliano, a post that puts her in the service of the ghost king, Brago.

claims.summary: Adriana, captain of the guard of Paliano, served the ghost king Brago.

claims.subject: adriana

evidence.quote: beneath the bloodstained banner of a usurper queen: Marchesa, the Black Rose

claims.summary: Adriana denounces Marchesa as a usurper queen.
claims.limitation: Sourced from an in-universe proclamation; the speaker is the proclamation's named author.

claims.subject: marchesa

evidence.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago, ending his immortal existence
an assassin infiltrated the palace, by some accounts walking through stone walls, in order to reach Brago's chambers

claims.summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering Brago; Leovold's dossier reports only rumor of an assassin who reached Brago's chambers.
claims.limitation: Accounts conflict and are in-universe accusation and rumor; these pages do not name the killer.

claims.subject: selvala

evidence.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

claims.summary: Selvala drafted Paliano's Charter alongside Brago, before his death (past era).
claims.limitation: 'She' is Selvala, the subject of that dossier entry.

claims.subject: leovold

evidence.quote: no one knows that better than Ambassador Leovold of Trest

claims.summary: Leovold is the Ambassador of Trest in Paliano.

claims.subject: grenzo

evidence.quote: Grenzo has adopted a different tactic, one that simultaneously surprises me more and less than the ones he has employed before—open rebellion

claims.summary: Grenzo, Warden of the Royal Dungeons, turned to open rebellion after losing Brago's patronage.

claims.subject: grenzo

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, the goblins Grenzo and Daretti have plans to cause chaos of a different kind.

claims.summary: The goblins Grenzo and Daretti scheme together to cause chaos in Paliano.
claims.limitation: Shared plans are stated; a formal alliance is not.

claims.subject: don_revari

evidence.quote: Given that he was looking to hire her, Kaya had a pretty good guess which one of those rumors was true.

claims.summary: Don Revari seeks to hire Kaya to banish a ghost from his house.
claims.limitation: 'He' is Don Revari, named elsewhere in the story.
